column1: # How the study's servers read Accept-Encoding (RFC 9110 §12.5.3), one
# header a line: the header as a Go string literal, then whether gzip and
# deflate are accepted. The sluice program (comparison/sluice/compress.go),
# R (comparison/sluice/reference) and go-nethttp's optimised variant each
# play this table in their tests, so that a malformed header gets the same
# answer from every reading; R and the optimised variant serve gzip alone
